professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and communication domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed areas of emerging strength such as social engagement and learning potential, alongside needs in fine motor coordination and behavioral regulation where intervention is warranted. These areas of challenge impact Sabrina's functional performance in daily activities, suggesting the need for a multidisciplinary intervention approach. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to address these needs and facilitate developmental progression. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy and possibly speech and physical therapy will be beneficial for optimal developmental support. Prognosis is positive with consistent support; thus, regular monitoring and reassessment will be critical to track Sabrina's progress and adapt intervention plans as necessary to achieve functional independence and developmental milestones. Family education and involvement will be essential to bolstering Sabrina's growth and engagement in everyday activities.
